body:
Closes #386

The two commits from the third 4x2 witness variant that missed the #389 merge window (the PR was merged while this work was still landing on its branch):

- **The actual bug**: `LongRunSolver.sliceConstraints` kept facing (dF) constraints at the window-end tick; facing arrays are length n against the positions' n+1, so a seam dF constraint in a sliced window threw ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException in `JumpConstraintCompiler.evaluate` whenever the window SLP survived phase 1. Three nested silent catches (race arm, per-node GraphRunner, B&B futures) turned the crash into a clean-looking 93 ms miss with the free-start machinery never running. Fix: the slicer caps Mode.F ticks at the window's last input; the seam constraint is enforced by the successor window, so nothing is lost.
- **Never silent again**: all three catch sites print full stacks (B&B keeps expected timeouts quiet). A solver-path crash can no longer masquerade as a miss.
- The third witness pair is pinned as `problems/solve/gh386-4x2c-seedshift` / `gh386-4x2c-luckyseed` (both solve with identical objective 6525.826886 from any probed seed).

Gates (run on the branch these commits came from, code-identical here on top of #389's merge): all gh386 pins green, sweep 104/104 with zero per-capture outcome changes, in-box seed-parity screen clean, `:core:check -PslowTests` green; fast suite plus the c-pins re-verified after the cherry-pick.
title: fix(solver): window-seam dF crash fix and unsilenced solver-path exceptions
